fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — for search-volume estimates, competitor selection, and compliance framing

fields.label: Prepared By / Agency Name (optional)
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER

fields.label: Plan Date (optional)
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — defaults to today's date if left blank
fields.fallback_instruction: Defaults to today's date if left blank.

fields.label: Primary Service Being Expanded
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — the single root service this whole plan is built around, e.g. "Google Ads Management," "Social Media Marketing," "Bookkeeping Services"

fields.label: Primary Pillar Page (existing or target URL)
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — e.g. trafficradius.com.au/google-ads-management/. If it doesn't exist yet, state "not yet built — target slug: ___"

fields.label: Existing Phase 1 Assets (optional)
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER or leave blank — every Phase 1: Core Service asset (the Step 2 list) already built for the primary service, each with the measured facts of what it is (title, length, sections, stated scores, offers, message counts) and an excerpt, plus the keyword clusters' measured volumes. If nothing exists yet, say "greenfield — Phase 1 not started."

fields.label: Sub-Services to Expand Into (Phase 2)
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — the sub-services of the primary service confirmed for Phase 2, one per line: name — status (existing page on the client's site, or new) — the existing page's URL or a proposed slug — the keyword cluster with each keyword's monthly search volume — the combined volume — and the volume source (DataForSEO for a named country, or "not measured"). If you want these inferred rather than supplied, say "infer 6-10 sub-services from the primary service and industry norms."

fields.label: Industry Verticals to Target (Phase 3, optional)
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — the industries/business types this service is commonly sold into, e.g. E-commerce, Trades, Healthcare, Professional Services, Real Estate, Hospitality. If left blank, infer from the ICP document.
fields.fallback_instruction: If left blank, infer from the ICP document.

fields.label: Locations to Target (Phase 3, optional)
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — cities/regions worth a dedicated location page. If left blank, infer the top 6-8 population/commercial centres for the stated Region / Country.
fields.fallback_instruction: If left blank, infer the top 6-8 population/commercial centres for the stated Region / Country.

fields.label: ICP Document
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — paste, attach, or say "use the ICP established earlier in this conversation." Should cover avatar, pains, goals, decision criteria, awareness level, and objections.

fields.label: CRO / Messaging Framework (optional)
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER or leave blank — paste, attach, or reference the CRO audit / psychological-layer framework already established, so tone and locked terminology carry through every asset in this plan.

fields.label: Existing Funnels / Lead Magnets (optional)
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER or leave blank — reference any funnel document or lead magnet already established, so this plan is additive rather than duplicative.

fields.label: Existing Value Ladder / Offers (optional)
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER or leave blank — reference any value ladder already established, so funnel conversion events point at real, already-defined next steps (consultation, audit, retainer tier) rather than inventing new ones.

fields.label: Brand Design Reference (optional)
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — a design-system reference already established in this conversation, OR the live website URL to extract from, OR explicit brand values, if any HTML deliverables are required as part of this plan.

fields.label: Competitor List
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — the competitor research already approved in this engagement, or a file/spreadsheet of 3-6 direct competitors in this industry and region. Used for the current-state content gap analysis and the "why we rank sub-services this way" reasoning. If none supplied, name 3-6 well-known competitors from general knowledge and flag this as an assumption.
fields.fallback_instruction: If none supplied, name 3-6 well-known competitors from general knowledge and flag this as an assumption.

fields.label: Keyword / Search Volume Data Source (optional)
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — attach or reference a keyword research export if one exists. If left blank, use the volumes supplied with the sub-services and Phase 1 keyword clusters, and label every other volume figure as an estimate, not verified data.
fields.fallback_instruction: If left blank, state estimated monthly search volumes using judgement and clearly label every volume figure as an estimate, not verified data.

fields.label: Plan Length
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — number of months to plan across, default 12

fields.label: Number of Phases
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — default 3 (Core Service / Sub-Service / Full Sitemap Expansion). State a different number and their names if this business needs a different shape, e.g. a 2-phase plan for a smaller operator.

fields.label: Delivery Capacity
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — solo operator, small team, or full agency; affects how many assets per month are realistic to commit to in the timeline

fields.label: Regulated Field Flag
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER — Yes/No. If yes, name the regulation so no-guarantee, compliance-safe language is applied throughout every asset description.

fields.label: Regulation Name
fields.raw_explanation: Name the regulation so no-guarantee, compliance-safe language is applied throughout every asset description.

fields.label: Additional Notes / Constraints (optional)
fields.raw_explanation: YOUR ANSWER or leave blank
